code_level_checks.GP_band_flux: Own recorded inclusive band slices cover gpoints 1–128 exactly once in ascending order. Reviewed angular.transfer sums each slice with pi conversion and correct bottom-first orientation.
code_level_checks.emissivity: Legacy plankbnd already includes emissivity and is not multiplied again. GP raw SOURCE_SURFACE is multiplied by matching per-band EMIS once; transfer helper also applies surface reflectivity consistent with its reviewed recurrence.
code_level_checks.fractions_and_scalars: Uses actual fraction sums per band/layer rather than assuming unity, reports their extrema; verifies WTDIFF=.5, relies on immutable actual source/packet shape and scalar applicability attested by prior reviews.
code_level_checks.immutability: Refuses existing result.json, verifies all pinned file hashes before and after calculation. No production or frozen input edits.
code_level_checks.legacy_band_flux_units: Saved band flux has WTDIFF already applied; conversion uses only DELWAVE*FLUXFAC. Float64 reporting reductions do not purport to reproduce original float32 accumulation bitwise.
code_level_checks.legacy_source_units: Planck times current-layer fraction sum times DELWAVE*WTDIFF*FLUXFAC/pi; uses captured default-real FLUXFAC, reports conversion-rounding departure from exact 10000.
code_level_checks.physical_band_alignment: Exact edge gate compares bands 3–13 (zero-based 2:13). Only these receive paired comparisons. Bands 1–2/14–16 are retained as separate engine-native totals. No cross-engine g-point pairing or opacity/source swapping.
code_level_checks.quadrature: Gauss-Jacobi alpha=0,beta=1, mu=(x+1)/2 and w/2 corresponds to 2*mu radiance measure; checks max successive change across all 16 bands, 46 interfaces and UP/DN <=1e-9 W/m2, orders256/512/1024/2048, fails if none converge. This is the declared band-flux criterion, not a new band-heating convergence claim.
code_level_checks.same_engine_gate: Discrete policy1 sum across all 16 computed bands must reproduce retained GP UP/DN at <=1e-10 W/m2 before new integral comparisons; retained legacy 12-field exact recurrence review is pinned, not repeated.
code_level_checks.source_face_orientation: Bottom-first legacy lower face uses oldlev[:-1] and upper face oldlev[1:], both weighted by the current layer fractions. GP adjacent SOURCE_LEVEL sums remain separately reported; no synthetic shared interface fraction.
code_level_checks.state_and_policy: Pressure, temperature, surface temperature and emissivity direct equality gates plus pinned state applicability review. Matched45 dry carrier and N2=.7808 remain diagnostic and do not assert exactly recovered legacy N2 composition.

scope_limits: Static review only; analysis.main, transfer, quadrature and any recurrence were not invoked. Numerical acceptance and actual convergence remain to be established by the root-authorized calculation.

The current numerical plan compares source/flux reductions. It cannot uniquely partition source interpolation, angular transport, correlated-k discretization or coefficient causes and is not an independent physical/optical truth oracle.
140 versus128 gpoints remain engine-specific. Fractions normalization is reported rather than renormalized; source face reductions preserve each engine closure.
Legacy REAL32 packet values are promoted to REAL64 for reporting; per-band reporting need not sum bitwise to the originally REAL32 accumulated broadband flux.
Diagnostic45=32 native+13 extensions; no native45 WRF-state or latest production-equivalence claim.
No source swap, new compiled RTE calculation, model, build, compiler or tests were executed by this review.
